g.text: House Rules / LED pin fit template
PRINT AT 100% / ACTUAL SIZE. Disable “fit to page”. Verify the 50 mm scale first.
Seven modules: front/LED-face view. Holes shown through the module bodies.
Nominal body: 12.7 × 17.8 mm. Centre pitch: 12.70 mm. Lead grid: 2.54 × 7.62 mm.
Hole circles: Ø0.9 mm. Proposed copper pad: Ø1.4 mm. PCB: 88.4 × 17.3 mm.
Pins face you. This view is mirrored left/right.
Pin 1 is upper-right when the module is upright
Orientation diagrams enlarged ×3 for readable pin numbers
Identify the physical pin-1 corner; use the pin numbers, not readable side text.
At low current, pin 1 is the positive column anode and pin 12 the negative row cathode.
That pair should light the upper-left dot in the front view. Verify other rows/columns too.
A fit print verifies geometry only. It does not verify polarity, pad mapping, brightness or current.
The uploaded rear photo is rotated relative to these upright diagrams.
Check all three selected groups of seven modules against this template.
Design check drawing / 29 October 2026 / not a PCB manufacturing file
